title: OptiFrame
description: The Most Optimized FPS Boost Pack (Max perfomance)
body:
# OptiFrame: The Most Optimized FPS Experience --- **OptiFrame** is an ultra-performance project designed to deliver the highest possible FPS in Minecraft without affecting gameplay. Unlike other modpacks, OptiFrame comes pre-configured for **Extreme Performance** right out of the box. To achieve a better **FPS Boost** than any other solution, the pack uses aggressive optimization techniques, such as fine-tuned entity culling and optimized render distance. Based on our benchmarks, OptiFrame is **50% faster on average** than other popular optimization packs. In heavy stress tests, it delivers up to **84% better performance**, ensuring your game stays smooth even in the most demanding situations. > **Note:** All performance settings are fully customizable. If you have a powerful PC, you can easily increase the render distance or entity limits in the game menu. --- ### 🚀 Performance & Features * **Maximum Optimization:** Custom configurations that limit unnecessary rendering to squeeze every single frame from your hardware. * **Visual Enhancements:** Smooth gameplay without lags. * **Integrated Downloader:** Download shaders and resource packs directly through the in-game settings. * **Better Than Others:** Specialized engine tweaks that often outperform most popular optimization packs in raw benchmarks. --- ### 📊 Benchmarks & Comparison We tested **OptiFrame** against the most popular optimization modpacks under the same conditions (Render Distance: 12, Same Seed, Same Settings). | Modpack | Stress Test FPS | Max FPS | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **🥇 OptiFrame** | **617** (🚀 +80% avg) | **1814** (📈 +15% avg) | | Simply Optimized | 405 | 1714 | | Remarkably Optimized | 352 | 1621 | | Fabulously Optimized | 273 | 1394 | | *Average Competition* | *343* | *1576* | **Test System Specs:** * **CPU:** AMD Ryzen 5 3600 * **GPU:** AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT * **RAM:** 32GB DDR4 * **OS:** Windows 11 --- ### 📸 Proof Screenshots
